name_note: Besides Oxalobacter formigenes, GTDB splits closely related genomes into further species such as Oxalobacter aliiformigenes, paeniformigenes and paraformigenes, which the older literature treats as O. formigenes.

sentences.text: Oxalobacter formigenes is described as the oxalate-degrading specialist among oxalate-degrading intestinal bacteria.
Such bacteria are reported to have the potential to reduce urinary oxalate excretion in humans and thereby limit the risk of calcium oxalate kidney stone formation.
In a proof-of-concept study in healthy adults, all 22 participants were colonized after a single dose and 10 remained colonized for at least one year.
Colonization was lost in 11 of those participants, 9 of whom reported antibiotic use.
A systematic review of nine studies examined interventions including Oxalobacter formigenes preparations proposed to reduce urinary oxalate excretion and stone recurrence.

references.authors: Fargue S, Suryavanshi M, et al.
references.title: Inducing Oxalobacter formigenes Colonization Reduces Urinary Oxalate in Healthy Adults.
